intervals.label: design/construction preparation
intervals.note: See the experiment:nexo interval note. No source consulted (checked 2026-10-25) gives a physical-construction start date. `start` (2018) is the date of the earliest dated nEXO design document found (the Pre-Conceptual Design Report), a lower bound and not a true start date.
intervals.quote: A consortium of over 150 scientists and technologists from 31 institutions and eight countries are contributing to the design and construction of nEXO.

intervals.label: US-led project paused (listed by SNOLAB, December 2024)
intervals.note: Recorded as an annotation (kind phase) with status `proposed`. SNOLAB Report, slides dated 26 May 2026, slide 26 'SNOLAB Cryopit Timeline': the first entry, dated 'Dec 2024', says "US led nEXO project was paused."; the next entries are XLZD approved as a conceptual design study at SNOLAB (August 2025) and Canadian scientists joining the XLZD collaboration (March 2026). The nEXO website (nexo.llnl.gov, undated; read again 2026-10-25) still says "The nEXO experiment is under development", and SNOLAB's 31 July 2026 talk lists 'nEXO 2.0' among illustrative future-project ideas that 'does not indicate SNOLAB approval or space allocation'. No source says the project was cancelled, so it is not recorded as `cancelled`. The date is the one printed on the SNOLAB slide; no source consulted gives the pause's own announcement.
intervals.quote: US led nEXO project was paused.

name: nEXO detector
notes: Placed at site:snolab-underground-lab, the SNOLAB underground laboratory.

placements.note: SNOLAB is the planned location: the nEXO site describes the detector in the future tense ('will be built in SNOLAB', 'will be located two kilometers underground in the SNOLAB Cryopit'); no source consulted (checked 2026-10-25) says it has been installed there.
placements.quote: the experiment will be built in SNOLAB, a deep mine. At two kilometers down, the rock overburden protects the entire experiment from cosmic radiation that is too energetic to be stopped by artificial shields.

enrichment.quote: so we use xenon that is enriched to 90% in that isotope

isotope.quote: nEXO will search for neutrinoless double beta decay in 5,000 kg of the xenon-136 (136Xe) isotope

target_mass.quote: nEXO will search for neutrinoless double beta decay in 5,000 kg of the xenon-136 (136Xe) isotope

summary.plain: A proposed tank of five tonnes of liquid xenon, planned for a deep Canadian mine, designed to be much more sensitive than its predecessor EXO-200.
summary.technical: Proposed single-phase liquid-xenon TPC, 5 t of 136Xe enriched to ~90%, planned for the SNOLAB 2 km level; scales up the EXO-200 design by roughly 25x in xenon mass.

technology.quote: As in EXO-200, the nEXO TPC is a LXe single-phase apparatus, a choice dictated by simplicity, resulting in fewer components and lower background.
